newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rautaruukki rises on '96 earnings report.
newsitem.headline: Rautaruukki rises on '96 earnings report.

text.p: Shares in Finnish steel group Rautaruukki Oy rose sharply on Thursday after the company reported 1996 earnings down on 1995 but above analysts' average expectations, brokers said.
At 1105/0905 GMT Rautaruukki traded up 1.80 markka, or more than four percent, at 44.00 markka, but off a session high of 44.50, in lively eight million markka volume.

Rautaruukki's 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax fell 25 percent to 715 million markka, but clearly beat the 660 million markka median forecast. Rautaruukki also said it expected steel prices to rise and profit to improve.
